title: FDA: Laser Light Shows
why: The US regulator's plain summary of the rules, forms and notices.

title: FDA Form 3147
why: The variance conditions in the regulator's wording: 3.0 m and 2.5 m separation, no audience scanning by default, FAA notice.

title: FAA Advisory Circular 70-1B
why: Outdoor shows, flight zones and the filing process.

title: ILDA: Audience scanning safety
why: The trade body's explanation of MPE and its recommended limits, clear about what is and is not law.

title: DGUV Information 203-036 (German)
why: The most detailed free regulator-side document on show lasers, with diagrams and checklists.

title: HSE: The safety of laser lighting displays
why: The UK position on one page, with the pointer to PLASA's guide.

title: ILDA: Camera sensor damage
why: Thresholds, cases and practical notes on lasers and cameras.

title: O'Hagan PhD thesis (1998)
why: The deepest free study of show laser risk and UK regulatory history.
